|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai-2022-12-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai-2022-01-15.gif]], 15 January 2022) → [[File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai-2022-12-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif]], 12 December 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 3 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT)]]): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-greenleaderingreensq91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-greenleaderingreensq3f533fb">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f533fb998049f07503e71ef72b1853837190622 commit 3f533fb] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
